summary: ws_time_online_statistics: role profile sources (profile_member, profile_speaker, profile_buyer, profile_moderator) are declared in the mobile maps but not in the contract

ai.s: Decides how role-specific profile screens (member, speaker, buyer, moderator) should appear in the mobile source contract.
ai.pr: Role profile sources were declared in the mobile maps but not in SourcePagesEnum or Sources v2, and profile_buyers duplicated profile_buyer.
ai.wy: Low volume but seen on up to 25 tenants, so these are real screens reporting outside the contract.
ai.oc: A decision between one generic profile source or one per role is needed, with the plural duplicate retired on the client.

summary: ws_time_online_statistics: app lifecycle events arrive as page sources (splash show, login otp, external login, dev-showcase-grid) — decide whether they are tracked at all

ai.s: Decides whether app lifecycle moments (splash, login steps, a dev screen) should be tracked as page sources in online-time statistics.
ai.pr: Seven non-page values such as "splash show", "login otp" and a production dev-showcase-grid arrived in the same urn column as real pages.
ai.wy: Clean mobile time-online reports; a development screen should not report from production.
ai.oc: A product decision per signal is needed: drop, rename or keep, including whether unauthenticated login steps should produce online time.

summary: ws_time_online_statistics: nine product pages report sources that are not in the contract — most look like re-spellings of slugs that already exist

ai.s: Decides per value what to do with nine mobile product-page sources outside the contract, most of them re-spellings of existing slugs.
ai.pr: Screens such as chat_list, schedule_sessions and product_favorite_list reported sources missing from SourcePagesEnum and Sources v2.
ai.wy: The same screens were split across names in mobile reports.
ai.oc: Each value is to be mapped to its existing slug, added to the contract or dropped.

summary: Open the event approval button to the people who really do the approval

ai.s: Gives the event Approve button to the people who actually approve events, rather than a hardcoded list of admin ids.
ai.pr: EP-57006 restored a hardcoded approver id list that does not match today's approvers and can only change with a release; Delete and Set Active are gated by the shared 613 account.
ai.wy: Event approval is a commercial decision owned by Susan, Ajay and finance.
ai.oc: The approver set is to be named and decided as a list, role or manageable permission, with Delete and Set Active reviewed on the same basis.

summary: Find out why Manager users get superadmin permissions inside a customer admin panel

ai.s: Investigates why Manager users, TAMs included, get superadmin rights inside customer admin panels via single sign-on.
ai.pr: Manager SSO logged everyone into customer admins as shared tenant account 613, the seeded superadmin, so any "is superadmin" check passed for all of them.
ai.wy: Follow-up from EP-57006; every 613-based check on any admin screen has the same security hole.
ai.oc: The identity problem is to be traced from IndexController's Manager sign-on and the affected checks listed.

summary: HeaderMobileMenu mounts LanguageSelector twice, toggled only by CSS

ai.s: Stops the mobile header menu mounting the language selector twice, which built every language link twice on each render.
ai.pr: HeaderMobileMenu rendered LanguageSelector for mobile and desktop, toggled only by CSS, so both ran and data-tour matched two nodes.
ai.wy: Frontend performance and correctness for organiser custom CSS and product tours; found in the PR #7274 review.
ai.oc: Only one LanguageSelector instance is to mount per viewport.

summary: Add TanStack Query as the client server-state layer and shrink Redux to client state

ai.s: Introduces TanStack Query as portal-ui's server-state layer and shrinks Redux to genuine client state.
ai.pr: Server data was cached by hand in classic Redux, with 22 ad-hoc freshness checks, 33 force-refetch sites, 5 copies of one endpoint and 17 contexts reimplementing lists.
ai.wy: Frontend tech debt and performance, measured in an audit of master-next14 on 7 Sep 2026.
ai.oc: A standard query cache is to replace hand-written TTLs, invalidation and loading flags, slice by slice.

summary: Native Integration - Jotform — Phase 1: Inbound

ai.s: Adds a native inbound Jotform integration that imports exhibitors from Jotform form submissions every five minutes.
ai.pr: Exhibitor data collected in Jotform had no native route into ExpoPlatform.
ai.wy: Integration Hub expansion for clients using Jotform to gather exhibitor data.
ai.oc: An API-key polled Jotform → EP sync with created_at delta, submission-id matching and EU routing is specified.

summary: Global Search. Blocks, Labels, Order and Availability Control

ai.s: Gives control over Global Search blocks, labels, order and availability (detail is in a linked Confluence page only).
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
ai.wy: Reported by IMEX, part of the Search Anatomy epic.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; marked Done.

summary: Session Calendar: Sync "By Track" Side Drawer tab label with the configured Display Filter name from Admin Panel

ai.s: The Session Calendar side drawer tab now shows the organiser's configured name for the Tracks filter, including translations, instead of a hardcoded "By Track".
ai.pr: The side drawer hardcoded "By Track" although organisers can rename Tracks (e.g. to Streams or Topics), as the rest of the platform respects.
ai.wy: Consistent terminology for clients who customise the label.
ai.oc: The tab label reads the Display Filter name from the Admin Panel, with localised variants; ready for release.

summary: Language Filter for Sessions and Exhibitor Events (Web)

epic.summary: New filters for Sessions and Exhibitor events

ai.s: Adds a language filter for sessions and exhibitor events on web (detail is in a linked Confluence page only).
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
ai.wy: Reported by DLG and HINTE; part of the new sessions and exhibitor events filters epic.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to let attendees filter sessions and exhibitor events by language.

summary: portal-ui: adopt the shared TrackTag and drop the local track color logic

ai.s: Switches portal-ui to the shared TrackTag component and removes its now-duplicated local track colour logic.
ai.pr: EP-57087 moved track colouring into the library's TrackTag, leaving a duplicate copy in portal-ui's trackColor helper.
ai.wy: Remove duplicated code once the library owns the behaviour.
ai.oc: Seven TrackList/TracksBlock mounts are to render TrackTag and the local colour code is to be deleted, once a library release ships.

summary: Language and Location Filters for Sessions and Exhibitor Events (Mobile App)

ai.s: Adds language and location filters to the mobile Sessions and Exhibitor Events pages, returning the same results as on web.
ai.pr: Mobile attendees lacked the language and location filters available on web.
ai.wy: Parity between app and web filtering.
ai.oc: Filters are specified with the web option sets, multi-select, AND logic, and grouped floorplan, online and custom locations.

summary: [Integration] Add sync_ts to contract for accountsInteractions sync

epic.summary: accountsInteractions: sync_ts cursor field to fix incremental-sync data loss

ai.s: Adds a sync_ts cursor to the accountsInteractions and sponsorInteractions APIs so clients can pull increments by server sync time without losing data.
ai.pr: Incremental pulls filtered by action time could miss records synced later, causing data loss for integrations.
ai.wy: Fix incremental-sync data loss for API clients.
ai.oc: sync_ts is returned per record and sync_from/sync_to accepted in the same millisecond format with a half-open window; in testing.

summary: Unify badge QR code generation & scanning (post-IMP-317/IMP-318 follow-up)

ai.s: Unifies badge QR code generation and scanning on one dedicated, unique QR field so lead scans can no longer resolve to the wrong exhibitor.
ai.pr: Badge QR codes encoded a bare account_id that could collide with external ids, so Android misattributed team-member scans (IMP-317/IMP-318).
ai.wy: Postmortem follow-up to prevent lead misattribution.
ai.oc: A DB-unique QR field, strict QR-only lookup in both apps, mobile test coverage and a plan for already-printed badges are scoped.

summary: [Reg-OT][BE][Payments][Part 2.1][Main-Split2] Purchasing: bring invoice and cumulative discounts back, and close the Part 2 review items

ai.s: Brings invoice payment and cumulative discounts back to the new Registration purchasing flow and closes the Part 2 review items.
ai.pr: Pay-by-invoice and cumulative discounts were switched off in Purchasing Part 2 (EP-56043), and review found defects shipped as known limitations.
ai.wy: Complete the new Registration payment path safely after the Part 2 release.
ai.oc: Features are to be re-enabled correctly, the recorded defects fixed, and diagnostics and suite gating landed first.

summary: Session Calendar View - Show starting and ending time slots only

ai.s: The mobile Session Calendar View grid starts at the first session's time slot and ends at the last, with no empty hours to scroll past.
ai.pr: The calendar grid rendered empty time slots above the first and below the last session.
ai.wy: Attendees should see the programme immediately on load.
ai.oc: The visible range is computed per day from the grid sessions, excluding all-day sessions, snapping to slot boundaries.

summary: Session Calendar View - All Day Sessions with fixed 44px +N button (Mobile)

ai.s: Mobile Calendar View moves sessions of 6 hours or more into an ALL DAY banner with a fixed 44px "+N" button, freeing the grid for shorter sessions.
ai.pr: Long sessions competed with time-specific sessions in the grid and squeezed their column width.
ai.wy: Mobile adaptation of the web behaviour in EP-57098.
ai.oc: Sessions of 6+ hours are promoted to a banner in 1- and 3-day modes, excluded from overlap calculation, and still openable.

summary: Create meeting stats tab in Embeddable Analytics page

ai.s: Adds a Meeting Analytics tab to the Embeddable Analytics page, with event, date and meeting-tag filters.
ai.pr: Meeting statistics were only in the legacy Analytics → General → Meetings page, not in the Embeddable dashboards.
ai.wy: Extends the Embeddable.com analytics pattern of EP-52392 and EP-54553.
ai.oc: A new dashboard tab is to show the documented meeting stats, split per selected meeting tag, while the legacy page stays.

summary: API V2 — Add filter_1 to filter_5 support on sessions/set

ai.s: API V2 sessions/set now accepts filter_1 to filter_5, so integrations can set custom session filters, matched in the request language.
ai.pr: Integrations could not set custom session filters through sessions/set.
ai.wy: Requested internally and by DLG for session data integrations.
ai.oc: Filters are applied leniently with per-slot errors, cleared with an empty string, and matched in the request language; done.
